## Positioning

Carlos works close to the business problem. He connects the systems a team depends on, removes manual work, and makes the flows that drive revenue faster and steadier. Recent work covers hotel connectivity and quoting at PriceTravel Holding, multi-tenant SaaS platforms at ListoApp, and Sócrates, an exam-generation tool for Dominican teachers.

## Headline Results

- −75% exam preparation time for teachers using Sócrates (about 40 to 10 minutes; about 90 to 15 minutes for lower digital-skill users)
- 9 hotel provider integrations built or hardened (5 new, 4 existing) for a travel quoting engine
- −50% AWS Lambda cold-start time through a pre-deployment bundling process

## Selected Work

### Sócrates: exam prep in minutes, not hours

Problem: Dominican teachers spent 40–90 minutes turning official MINERD curriculum into a usable exam.
Result: Sócrates generates an editable, curriculum-grounded DOCX exam in 10–15 minutes.
Stack: Document AI, OCR, structured extraction, DOCX generation.
Project URL: https://socrates.xavely.com

### Hotel quotes that stay in sync with live inventory

Problem: Quoting depended on many hotel providers with different behaviors and latency.
Result: Carlos built and hardened the provider connections and cached exchange rates and promotions. The quoting engine gets fresh rates and availability while hitting the database less.
Providers: SiteMinder (SiteConnect), TravelClick, Omnibees, Gin RateFox, and TravelGate HotelX (built); Hotelbeds, DerbySoft, SynXis, and Expedia Rapid API (optimized).
Stack: AWS DAX, background workers, hotel provider APIs.
Project URL: https://pricetravel.com

### One platform for insurers, providers, and agents

Problem: Two growing SaaS products needed to serve several user roles on shared infrastructure.
Result: Carlos built the backends behind Sektor.app and Centuria.app, with event-driven notifications that keep every party in the loop as work moves forward.
Stack: TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, MongoDB, AWS SNS/EventBridge.
Project URL: https://sektor.app/

### Live results from 128 sources, in real time

Problem: A live-data product (RoulettesView.com) needed fast-changing results from 128 roulette tables delivered to users instantly and without duplicates.
Result: Carlos built a concurrent collection pipeline and a real-time API that streams one clean event per change.
Stack: Go, WebSockets, Chrome-based scraping.

## Experience

- PriceTravel Holding — Backend Developer, Hotel Connectivity & Quoting (Jun 2024 – Present, remote). Owns hotel provider connectivity and the data paths behind the quoting engine.
- ListoApp (Chile) — Backend Developer, SaaS Platforms & Cloud (Feb 2024 – Present, remote). Backend and cloud delivery for SaaS products and client platforms, from API design to serverless performance and CI/CD.
- Drimo — Software Developer (Jul 2022 – Jun 2023, remote). Website and blog migration to a faster, SEO-friendly stack; serverless APIs; web and mobile features.

## How Carlos Helps

- Connect the systems a business runs on: products, providers, and partners share data reliably, without manual re-entry or out-of-sync records.
- Make critical flows fast and reliable: the flows that drive revenue respond faster, fail less, and ship through automated deployments.
- Turn repetitive work into minutes: automation and AI remove manual steps, while people stay in charge of the decisions that matter.
